problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{3}{2x}?$
worked_solution:
To plot $y=\frac{3}{2x},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/a32495fcca947d01cf8d3218fc5cfc0cce083a34e6fb6b629d92ba9e47039a6e.png)

- Stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{3}{2}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{3}{2x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/5a43656a35d47c7321e53d56238cd10f669bc807d57f72fcc002d79fb21aa111.png)
